trash.title: In Trash.
trash.body: You can read it here but not edit it. Restore it to keep working.
confirm.delete.title: Delete forever?
confirm.delete.message: “{title}” will be removed for good. This can't be undone.
locked.title: This note is locked
locked.body: Locked notes stay encrypted on disk and are left out of search.
pw.warning: If you forget this password, the note can't be recovered. There is no reset.
confirm.removeLock.title: Remove the lock?
confirm.removeLock.message: “{title}” will be stored without encryption again and will show up in search.
theme.label: Theme: {name}
toast.lockedUnsaved: Note locked before your last edit was saved. Unlock to save it.
toast.lockSet: Password set. The note stays open until it locks again.
settings.title: Settings
settings.spellcheckHelp: Underlines misspelled words while you write. On Linux and Windows the dictionary may be downloaded the first time you turn this on.
templates.help: Pick a template from the command palette: “New note from template…”. To make your own, open a note and choose “Save note as template…”.
templates.deleteMessage: “{name}” will be removed. Notes you made from it are not affected.
backups.help: A backup is one file with all your notes and tags. Pictures and other media are stored separately in the media folder inside the data folder, and they are never deleted automatically. To keep a full copy, save the backup file together with the media folder. CogNotez also makes a backup by itself once a day and keeps the last 7.
backups.restoreMessage: CogNotez will restart. Your notes will go back to how they were on {date}. A copy of your current notes is kept in the backups folder first.
palette.label: Command palette
palette.placeholder: Search notes or run an action…
palette.empty: No matches. Try a note title, or an action such as “split”.
empty.none.title: No notes yet
empty.none.body: Create your first note, or press {mod} K to search once you have some.
empty.pick.title: No note open
empty.pick.body: Pick a note from the list, or press {mod} K to search.
import.title: Import your notes from CogNotez 4
import.found: Found {n} notes. Your CogNotez 4 data is only read, never changed.
palette.noModels: No models found. Check the Companion settings.
palette.clearHistory: Clear Companion history for this note
ai.title: Companion
ai.clearNote: The conversation about this note will be deleted. The note itself is not changed.
ai.clearGlobal: The conversation that is not tied to a note will be deleted.
ai.locked: The Companion can't read locked notes.
ai.emptyNote: Ask about this note, or pick a quick action below.
ai.emptyGlobal: No note is open. You can still ask a general question.
ai.hint.local: Runs on this computer. Nothing is sent anywhere.
ai.hint.remote: Your note is sent to {provider} to answer.
ai.hint.research: Search results are treated as untrusted and can't edit your note.
ai.searchOn: web search on for this message
ai.cantInsert: That note isn't open for editing.
ai.nothingToRead: There is no text to work on yet.
ai.workingInline: Companion is working… Esc to stop
ai.busy: The Companion is already working on an edit.
ai.changed: The text changed while the Companion was working. Try again.
ai.tagsHelp: Pick the ones you want to add to this note.
ai.settings.insecure: This computer has no system keychain, so the key is stored without system encryption.
ai.settings.searxngHelp: With a SearXNG server, the Companion can offer “Web search” for a single message. It searches first and treats the results as untrusted text; search never lets it edit your note.
ai.settings.privacy: Local providers run on this computer. OpenRouter and other remote servers receive the text you send.
sync.deviceHelp: Shown on conflicted copies so you can tell which computer made them.
sync.folderHelp: Use a folder that Syncthing, Dropbox or Nextcloud keeps in sync.
sync.driveHelp: Notes are kept in a “CogNotez Sync” folder in your Drive. CogNotez can only see files it created.
sync.driveNeedsAccount: Connect a Google account below first.
sync.encryptHelp: Only used when this creates a new sync location. When you join an existing one, CogNotez asks for its passphrase if it has one.
sync.passphraseWarning: If you forget this passphrase, synced notes can't be recovered from the sync location.
sync.unlockHelp: Enter its passphrase to start syncing on this computer.
sync.disable: Turn off sync on this device
sync.disableNote: Your notes stay on this computer. Nothing is deleted from the sync location.
sync.disableTitle: Turn off sync on this device?
sync.disabled: Sync turned off on this device
sync.android: The Android app keeps using the old sync format until it's updated.
google.title: Google account
google.disconnectMessage: Drive sync will pause until you connect again. Nothing is deleted from Google Drive.
google.importHelp: Use the Desktop-app client JSON from your Google Cloud project, the same file CogNotez 4 used.
google.noClient: No Google OAuth client is set up yet.
conflict.title: Conflicted copy.
conflict.body: This note and “{title}” were both edited before they synced, so CogNotez kept both versions. Nothing was overwritten.
conflict.bodyGone: This note was edited in two places before they synced, so CogNotez kept both versions. Nothing was overwritten.
filter.conflicts.title: Conflicted copies
